# MedAtlas
> Plain-language educational directory and guide to 100+ medical devices across 15 health areas, founded by Ankush Kumar (MBA Pharmaceutical Management, B.Pharm).

## Educational Mission & Disclaimers
- MedAtlas is for general patient and student education; it is not a diagnostic tool or substitute for professional medical advice.
- Device specifications, regulatory status, indications, and local availability vary by country and model.
- Built in alignment with public nomenclature and reference materials from WHO Medical Devices, US FDA Product Code Classification, and the European Medical Device Nomenclature (EMDN).

## Health Areas
- [Heart & circulation](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Heart%20%26%20circulation): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Heart & circulation.
- [Diabetes & endocrine](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Diabetes%20%26%20endocrine): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Diabetes & endocrine.
- [Breathing & sleep](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Breathing%20%26%20sleep): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Breathing & sleep.
- [Neurology & mental health](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Neurology%20%26%20mental%20health): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Neurology & mental health.
- [Bones, joints & mobility](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Bones%2C%20joints%20%26%20mobility): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Bones, joints & mobility.
- [Digestive & liver](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Digestive%20%26%20liver): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Digestive & liver.
- [Kidney & urinary](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Kidney%20%26%20urinary): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Kidney & urinary.
- [Cancer care](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Cancer%20care): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Cancer care.
- [Surgery & wound care](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Surgery%20%26%20wound%20care): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Surgery & wound care.
- [Infection & testing](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Infection%20%26%20testing): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Infection & testing.
- [Eyes, ears & dental](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Eyes%2C%20ears%20%26%20dental): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Eyes, ears & dental.
- [Children & maternity](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Children%20%26%20maternity): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Children & maternity.
- [Rehabilitation & assistive](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Rehabilitation%20%26%20assistive): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Rehabilitation & assistive.
- [Self-care & monitoring](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Self-care%20%26%20monitoring): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Self-care & monitoring.
- [Hospital & pharmacy](https://medatlas.health/device-library.html?area=Hospital%20%26%20pharmacy): Medical devices used in screening, monitoring, diagnosis, and care for Hospital & pharmacy.
